audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree with each other on rows 0 and 1 (content win[0]=Warwick vs full phases[0].side=Skill; win[1]=Skill vs phases[1].side=Warwick), and the whole chart disagrees with the already-published mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit (garen__warwick) set Levels 1, 2, 3 and 4-5 to Garen, Level 6 to Warwick, and both item stages to Garen, and states both of its layers now match its packet row for row. Two rows here shipped two different answers to the same question.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror as one atomic group: Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Warwick, Garen, Garen, with ratings inverted from the mirror's (4/10 on Garen stages, 6/10 at Level 6). whys[0..3] rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never named the numbers that make Level 6 Warwick's stage or Courage the thing to bait.
audit.why: Courage is 22s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5, a shield with tenacity followed by lesser damage reduction. Judgment is 9s at rank 1. Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 for a 1.5s suppress, and Jaws of the Beast scales with the target's maximum health, which is why the one stage that beats a tank statline is 6.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[1].why, phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading text said to 'hold Q to follow his dash' — Garen has no dash, Decisive Strike is a Move Speed burst. late called Warwick's damage a 'DoT', which he does not have.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger is bonus magic damage on every basic attack that heals below 50% health and triples below 25%; resistances blunt it, not a damage-over-time. Perseverance regenerates a share of total health per second while he is untouched, so unfollowed chip is wasted. Demacian Justice is a true-damage execute on 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Dash reference removed, Eternal Hunger described by its real 50%/25% thresholds, Perseverance's regen condition stated in phases[0].why, and late rewritten around resistances plus the true-damage execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and late claim Garen's Q silence 'cancels' Warwick's Q and Infinite Duress, and nothing states whether Courage's tenacity shortens Primal Howl's fear or the Duress suppression.
audit.why: A silence denies casts; whether it interrupts an already-started channel is not in Riot's text, and neither is tenacity's interaction with suppression. needsResearch is empty by design, so these are UNKNOWN.
audit.corrected: Left the existing sentences untouched — the mirror agent made the same call on the same claim. Recorded in unverified.

audit.why: Both cannot be right. I aligned to the mirror because the two directions must never contradict, but the win rate points the other way.
